children: European shares are cautiously higher in the first hour of trading, helped by a dip in oil and gas prices, but the story of the week so far remains higher energy prices, higher bond yields and lower shares.
is up 0.2%, though still down nearly 2% on the week.
There isn't a huge amount of news going on under the surface either, perhaps the most notable mover is Novo Nordisk
down 2.8%, after a downgrade by Morgan Stanley.
Software stocks are also a bit weak, while banks, an investor darling, are among the winners. The sector index is up nearly 1%. (.SX7P)
